title: Non-Periodic Globally Optimized Stack Without Structural Assumptions
scientific_hypothesis: Removing periodicity and grading constraints allows the optimizer to find layer thickness combinations that periodic or chirped stacks cannot achieve, potentially discovering non-intuitive thickness sequences that better separate the UV reflection and SWIR transmission bands.
design_principle: Global optimization (L27) explores the full parameter space without structural priors. The optimizer may discover that certain layers should be thicker or thinner than quarter-wave, or that specific layer sequences break symmetry to improve performance in ways periodic designs cannot.
proposed_topology: Air | 28 layers of alternating HfO2 and SiO2 with individually optimized thicknesses | Fused Silica substrate
design_variables: all 28 individual layer thicknesses as independent variables
layer sequence order (which material starts at air interface)
soft_objectives: maximize combined score of UV reflectance and SWIR transmittance
discover if non-periodic thickness patterns outperform structured approaches
identify which layers are most sensitive to thickness variation
manufacturing_considerations: 28 layers within 30-layer limit, leaving margin for possible capping layer
no thickness constraints beyond physical realizability (5-400 nm per layer)
L27 notes global optimization can find designs tolerant to fabrication errors
theory_basis: Genetic algorithm optimization for thin-film stacks (L21)
L06 demonstrates optimization of dielectric media arrangement for spectral control
expected_advantages: No structural assumptions limit the search space
L27 demonstrates global optimization finds coatings meeting multiple spectral requirements
May discover thickness patterns that periodic designs miss
known_risks: Higher-dimensional optimization (28 variables) may converge slowly
Risk of overfitting to specific wavelength points rather than bands
L26 notes HfO2 defect formation may limit practical performance regardless of optimization
execution_request_english: Design a non-periodic multilayer dielectric coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees. The stack consists of 28 layers: alternating HfO2 and SiO2 (Lemarchand) starting with HfO2 adjacent to air. All 28 layer thicknesses are independent optimization variables with no periodicity or gradient constraints. Optimize all thicknesses simultaneously to maximize transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Total layer count is exactly 28. Materials are HfO2 and SiO2 (Lemarchand) only. Use global optimization algorithm to explore full parameter space.
